candidates.statement: Payment service returns 503 on POST /v1/authorizations, causing order to fail and gateway checkout to return 502.
candidates.uncertainty: Traces show payment 503 as the deepest error, but no payment-side logs or metrics are available to confirm the internal fault.

report.explanation: All three checkout traces show inventory succeeding (200) while payment returns 503, propagating to order 502 and gateway checkout 502. Topology confirms order depends on payment. Payment-side telemetry is absent, so the internal cause at payment is unconfirmed.
